name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-hoopster
title: Redrawn Styled Hoopster
description: A redrawn version of this sprite, it comes with some variants so you can choose the one you like the most, the red one uses the original red palette from redrawn, the one with black spots is meant to ressemble the in game sprite Hoopster had in other games, the one with pink spots is based on artworks, and the yellow one is how the enemy looked like in Super Mario Advance 1.
